diagram_previews.alt: A regular hexagon V0 to V5 with V0 at the bottom. A large gray sector of radius 600 surrounds V0 below the hexagon. Blue sectors of radius 480 at V1 and V5 lie on the two sides, and narrow green regions of radius 360 at V2 and V4 lie above the hexagon, clipped at the dashed line of symmetry through V0 and V3, which meets the outer arc at X. Gray dashed radii are labelled 600 and 480, and the boundary of the region at V2 is labelled 360.
